provenance: Typical values per material family and process rules of thumb, written for BaroCSS; no datasheet's, catalogue's or standard's text or tables. Every value is an estimate with a source id: verify against your grade's datasheet and your process.

sources.S-TYP: BaroCSS typical value for the material family, written for this table (not a grade's datasheet, not a standard's table): verify against your grade's datasheet
sources.S-DENS: BaroCSS typical density for the family, written for this table (the studio's earlier density list, kept)
sources.P-INJ: BaroCSS rule of thumb for injection moulding, written for this table (not a moulder's or a standard's text): verify with your moulder
sources.P-FDM: BaroCSS rule of thumb for FDM printing with a 0.4 mm nozzle, written for this table: verify with your printer and slicer
sources.P-SLA: BaroCSS rule of thumb for resin (SLA) printing, written for this table: verify with your printer and resin
sources.P-SLS: BaroCSS rule of thumb for powder-bed polymer sintering (SLS), written for this table: verify with your service or printer
sources.P-MJF: BaroCSS rule of thumb for multi-jet fusion (MJF), written for this table: verify with your service or printer
sources.P-PRN: BaroCSS generic printer, written for this table: a common build volume for its class, not a product's datasheet; set your own printer's
sources.P-ORI: BaroCSS heuristic for scoring print orientations, written for this table (weights of normalised terms): a default to adjust
sources.W-WEB: A public web page, read only, its value as printed there: each value names its page (URL), the date read and the page's own label (the value's `page`); converted from inches where the page gives both, the page's millimetres kept
sources.W-DERIVED: Derived from a public page by a stated rule, not a value as printed there: its `page` names the page read and its note the rule (e.g. a step read off the sizes the page lists)
